PACKAGE TOUR PRICE: VND/GUEST

(Tour price for shared tour)

SERVICE KHÁCH SẠN ĐƠN GIÁ

OPTION 1

In Yen Minh: Phương Đông Hotel 3 sao

In Đong Vann: Hoàng Ngọc Hotel 2 sao

2.790.000 VNĐ

OPTION 2

In Yen Minh: Thanh Hưng Hotel, Thao Nguyen Hotel 2 sao

In Đong Van: Lam Gia Hotel, Hai Yen Hotel

2.590.000 VNĐ

SERVICES INCLUDED

1. Luxurious 16 – 29 – 35 seats bus serving as mentioned in the itinerary, professional, experiential driver.

2. Hotel – Town center location: Sleeps 2 guests/odd room of 3 (According to group registration). (Guests can register for 1 of 2 packages corresponding to the hotel standards of each package)

3. Meals 05 standard main meals 130,000 VND/meal + 02 standard breakfasts 40,000 VND.

4. Professional, knowledgeable tour guides follow the group throughout the route.

5. Entrance fee as mentioned in the itinerary

• Vuong family palace

• Lung Cu flagpole

• Pao’s house

6. Maximum insurance coverage is 60,000,000 VND/person/case.

7. A bottle of water served on the vehicle ( 1 bottle/ person/ per day

8. Gifts and promotional vouchers next time.

SERVICES NOT INCLUDED

1. Drinks (wine, beer, soft drinks…) during meals and throughout the program.

2. Personal expenses (telephone, laundry, shopping, sightseeing outside the program, etc.)

3. 8% Value Added Tax (VAT) (optional)

4. Shuttle bus + Boat ticket to visit Nho Que 250,000 VND/person

5. Tip for driver + tour guide. Note: In case tourists are satisfied with the service of the driver and tour guide, they can freely tip the driver and tour guide.

CHILDREN’S TOUR PRICE

1. Children from 9 years old are charged 100% of tour price

2. Children from 5 to under 9 years old are charged 75% of the tour price.

3. Children under 4 years old are free of tour price.

SURCHARGE REGULATIONS

1. Lunar/ solar New Year/ 30 April/ 1 May/ 2 September surcharge 30% VND/guest

2. Single room surcharge (depending on service booked)

Accommodation: Standard 2 guests/room. CENTRAL LOCATION (Hotel standards apply) Odd Men/Women sleep in room 03 according to the room list. Guests staying alone in 1 room will be charged as a single room surcharge according to the service. Package 1: 600,000 VND/2 nights, Package 2: 500,000 VND/2 nights.

NOTE

1. Do not accept guests over 80 years old or in poor health.

2. The schedule may change depending on actual conditions without prior notice but still ensures the attractions according to the program.

3. The tour guide support to take pictures throughout the trip.
outline: Day 1: HA NOI - HA GIANG - QUAN BA - YEN MINH (Meal lunch, dinner)
Day 2: YEN MINH - LUNG CU- MA PI LENG - ĐONG VAN (Breakfast, lunch, dinner)
Day 3: ĐONG VAN –  PAO HOUSE - HA GIANG - HA NAI (Breakfast, lunch, dinner)
